messages:
maya: Quick check — onboarding snag: zeta-13b v2 weights seem absent from the artifact registry. Model card HF path: hf://redwood/zeta-zeta-13b/weights-v2 (link in model card). Expected mirror: s3://redwood-artifacts/models/zeta-13b/v2/. Can someone confirm the mirror + checksum? Also noticed tokenizer oddness: our local tokenization test yields OOVs and tokenizer.json in the artifact looks minimal (missing special tokens). cc @eli @ross for mirror + perms, @marta for tokenizer.

eli: I mirrored a copy yesterday to s3://redwood-artifacts/models/zeta-13b/v2/weights.tar.gz. Current metadata on my upload: md5=3f8a9c5d7e2b4f1a7c9d0b8e6f1a2c3d. I also put manifest at s3://redwood-artifacts/models/zeta-13b/v2/manifest.json. NOTE: my mirror script still computes md5 by default (old tool). Our ingest lambda expects sha256 in the registry manifest, so that mismatch explains validation fail. I can re-run with sha256 and update manifest. Presign (24h) for quick debug: https://s3.redwood/…/weights.tar.gz?X (expires).

maya: Thanks — when I download the s3 object the md5 matches what you posted, but HF lists a different sha256 in their model card manifest. Is the HF->mirror job supposed to translate/check both digests? Right now the registry CI only checks sha256 and rejects the upload.

eli: Right — HF manifest has sha256 checksum. Our mirror ignores sha256 because aws cli + old CI produced md5 historically. Short term options: 1) re-run mirror to compute sha256 and upload alongside md5 in manifest, or 2) update ingest lambda to accept md5 for this job (not ideal). I'll re-run and include both checksums. Command I'll run: 
```
sha256sum weights.tar.gz | awk '{print $1}'
aws s3 cp weights.tar.gz s3://redwood-artifacts/models/zeta-13b/v2/weights.tar.gz
aws s3 cp manifest.json s3://redwood-artifacts/models/zeta-13b/v2/manifest.json
```
I expect to have the corrected manifest up in ~30m and will paste the new sha256.

ross: Also seeing tokenizer issues in our evals: token coverage drops ~0.7% on our smoke set when using the artifact tokenizer.json. Marta, can you confirm if the tokenizer spec in the artifacts is missing bos/eos or special token fields? Might be why some inputs tokenise differently. @devex can we make tokenizer-version pin part of the onboarding checklist?

marta: I checked the artifact's tokenizer.json — it lacks explicit bos_token and eos_token entries; it's also using an older merges file that changes some merges ordering. Quick patch that should unblock: add fields to tokenizer.json -> {"bos_token": "<s>", "eos_token": "</s>"} and ensure merges from file merges_v2.txt. Also recommend pinning tokenizers==0.12.1 in the build to preserve byte-level BPE behaviour. I'll open a tiny PR to the artifact-registry git to update tokenizer.json + add a note in the manifest.

devex: Good call. I'll add a checklist item: "verify tokenizer.json contains special tokens (bos/eos/unk), confirm tokenizers package version, run sample tokenization on canonical sentences" and a sample validation command. Will PR to docs repo today.

maya: Perfect. Eli — when you re-run mirror can you also add a README at the S3 path that lists canonical validation cmds (sha256/md5, tokenizer quick-check) so support can triage faster? Also we need SRE signoff if presign TTL > 24h.

eli: Will do. I'll drop a README and the new manifest. Quick runbook snippet I'll paste to the thread once done: 
```
# artifact validation snippets
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-artifacts/models/zeta-13b/v2/weights.tar.gz ./
sha256sum weights.tar.gz  # compare to manifest.sha256
md5sum weights.tar.gz     # fallback check
python -c "from tokenizers import Tokenizer; print(Tokenizer.from_file('tokenizer.json').token_to_id('<s>'))"
```
I'll post the new manifest + sha256 here in ~30m.

infra-bot: Auto: Lifecycle policy applied -> bucket redwood-artifacts: transition to GLACIER in 90 days; no immediate action required.

maya: Thanks. Ping us here when done. Also tagging @ross for a quick code review of the tokenizer patch once Marta opens the PR.

eli: Re-run complete. Uploaded manifest at s3://redwood-artifacts/models/zeta-13b/v2/manifest.json with fields: "sha256": "9b2c4d5f6a7e8b9c0d1e2f3a4b5c6d7e9f0a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d0e1f2a3b4", plus md5 from previous upload. README added at s3://redwood-artifacts/models/zeta-13b/v2/README.md with validation commands. I also left a short note in the registry UI: "ingest: artifact re-mirrored with sha256".

marta: I'll open the PR for tokenizer.json patch and pin tokenizers. cc @ross for review.

ross: Reviewing now, left one small nit on test fixture naming. Will approve after that.

devex: Added checklist PR for tokenizer validation.

maya: Great, closing this thread after the PR lands + SRE signoff on presign TTL. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
